cohort: Nursing mothers attending a child health clinic at a General Hospital in Rivers State, Nigeria, for their new borne.
finding: The study identified significant associations between exclusive breast feeding (EBF) and various maternal and spouse demographic factors, as well as antenatal care attendance, gestational age, mode of delivery, parity, and birth order.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (MOD) was identified as a significant variable associated with and influencing exclusive breast feeding (EBF).
cross-section timing: Among nursing mothers attending a child health clinic for their new borne, without a specific postpartum duration mentioned for the measurement of EBF.
